chunks: Al-Shaykh Abu 'Abd Allah, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah and al-Saffar together, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Abd Allah ibn Yahya, from Ibn Muskan, who said:

Abu Basir narrated to me, saying: I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about excrement falling into a well. He said: Ten buckets are to be drawn from it; if it has dissolved, then forty or fifty buckets.

key_terms.أَرْبَعُونَ أَوْ خَمْسُونَ دَلْوًا: forty or fifty buckets; the increased amount required when the impurity dissolves
key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: the well into which the impurity falls
key_terms.الْعَذِرَةِ: excrement; the impurity discussed in the ruling
key_terms.ذَابَتْ: it dissolved; meaning the impurity dispersed in the water
key_terms.عَشْرُ دِلَاءٍ: ten buckets; the required amount to be drawn in the first case
key_terms.يُنْزَحُ: it is to be drawn out; referring to removing water from the well

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if excrement falls into a well according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning the purification of a well when excrement falls into it. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that ten buckets should be drawn, but if the impurity has dissolved, then forty or fifty buckets should be drawn, indicating a greater cleansing requirement when contamination spreads.
